module.name: Containers
mode.hint: Copy mode takes copies out of the container without removing them
command.open: Opens the container you're holding or looking at, or your ender chest
ender_chest.no_backend: Your ender chest needs the mod on the server, or op on a vanilla server.
help.open.title: Containers: /open [echest]
help.open.1: Opens the held container item, or the block or entity you're looking at. /open echest opens your ender chest.
help.open.2: Changes save as soon as you make them, and any item fits in any slot.
help.open.3: Chests, hoppers, furnaces and other plain containers map each slot straight to the container's slot.
help.open.4: Special containers give each slot a meaning: the record in a jukebox, the book on a lectern, the item in an item frame, pot or suspicious block.
help.open.5: Mobs show their armor and hands, and horses, llamas and other mounts also show their saddle, body armor and chest.
